progressSyncIntro: Page streaming updates reading progress, so OPDS apps resume across devices and count as real reading.
progressSyncNote: Streaming a page from an OPDS app advances your resume point (never backwards); fetching the last page marks the issue read — the same record the built-in reader keeps. Whole-file downloads are unaffected (no progress channel exists for them). A client can opt out per-request with ?progress=0 on the stream URL.
connectNote: Add this catalog to an OPDS-capable reader app to browse and stream your library there. Sign in with your BackIssue username and password.
